description:
Adds a billing rate to the billing rate level list. After a billing rate is created, it can be assigned to an employee or vendor (VendorAdd/Mod, EmployeeAdd/Mod) via the BillingRateRef element in the appropriate request. Then, once the billing rate is assigned to an employee or vendor, if you use that employee or vendor in a time transaction (TimeTrackingAdd), then the billing rate will override the rate specified by the service item used in the time transaction.

The `billing_rate_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

adjust_billing_rate_relative_to.description:
Specifies the service item rate that `adjust_percentage` is applied to. Normally, this is set to StandardRate.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`custom_rate`, `custom_rate_percent`), or the set (`adjust_billing_rate_relative_to`, `adjust_percentage`). Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

adjust_percentage.description: Choose exactly one of: the set (`custom_rate`, `custom_rate_percent`), or the set (`adjust_billing_rate_relative_to`, `adjust_percentage`). Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

custom_rate.description:
The value specified here overrides the rate of the service item referenced in this aggregate (in the `item_ref`) with the rate you specify here.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`custom_rate`, `custom_rate_percent`), or the set (`adjust_billing_rate_relative_to`, `adjust_percentage`). Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

custom_rate_percent.description:
Using this field with BillingRateAdd will work only if the service item itself is set to a percentage, not to an amount.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`custom_rate`, `custom_rate_percent`), or the set (`adjust_billing_rate_relative_to`, `adjust_percentage`). Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

item_ref.description: `item_ref` may accept all item types or a restricted subset, depending on the request.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

fixed_billing_rate.description:
You use `fixed_billing_rate` if you want the rate to override all service items rates.

Choose exactly one of: `fixed_billing_rate`, or `billing_rate_per_item`.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

name.description: Name is the case-insensitive short name of a list object (without ancestors). It must be unique within its hierarchy scope.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.
